description: This line plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" on the y-axis, which is scaled linearly from 0.1 to 0.5, against an x-axis representing model input size, scaled logarithmically from 512 to 1024. The plot displays four distinct lines, each corresponding to a different model and evaluation benchmark as indicated in the legend. The blue line, representing LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep, starts at approximately 0.22 and increases to about 0.47. The orange line, for Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench, begins at approximately 0.17 and rises to about 0.55. The green line, for LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench, starts near 0.08 and increases to approximately 0.49. The red line, for Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep, begins at approximately 0.25 and rises to about 0.60. All lines show an increasing trend as the input size increases, with the red line consistently having the highest ratio and the green line the lowest.
